idea-plugin.name: Dep Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Dep Lens shows dependency health signals directly in your editor so you can quickly evaluate third-party packages while coding.

The plugin resolves dependency source repositories and renders inline hints (Inlay Hints), including:

  • GitHub star count
  • Repository last update date

Supported contexts

  • Go: import and go.mod dependencies
  • Java/Kotlin: import-based dependency resolution
  • Maven: pom.xml dependencies
  • Gradle: build.gradle and build.gradle.kts dependency declarations
  • JavaScript/TypeScript: imports and package.json dependency sections

Dep Lens uses local cache files and public package/repository metadata to keep hints responsive and reduce repeated network requests.
